## What changed and why

Describe the improvement and who it helps. Link an existing issue, discussion, or improvement proposal when relevant. A separate proposal is optional for small, reversible changes.

## Sources and scope

Link evidence for factual claims. Note dates for current activity or funding information, and distinguish proposals from existing capabilities.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check:site`
- [ ] Affected pages inspected on desktop and mobile, or not applicable (explain below).

List any failed, blocked, or unrun checks and known limitations. Add screenshots for visible changes when useful.

## Agent assistance, if any

Describe the agent's role and what the submitting contributor verified. Do not include private prompts, credentials, or confidential source material.

## Review notes

List open questions, follow-up work, and who can authorize the change. If this includes a proposal, state its status and link any actual decision. Merging a draft does not adopt its recommendations or authorize funding or on-chain actions. Merging into `v4` triggers site deployment.
